info.name: Hotel Offer Orchestrator
info.description: Smoke tests for hotel aggregation, Redis price filtering, mock suppliers, and health.

item.name: Get Delhi offers - deduplicated best prices

exec: pm.test('Hotel names are unique', () => { const names = body.map(x => x.name.toLowerCase()); pm.expect(new Set(names).size).to.eql(names.length); });
pm.test('Holtin uses Supplier B best price', () => { const holtin = body.find(x => x.name === 'Holtin'); pm.expect(holtin).to.include({ price: 5340, supplier: 'Supplier B', commissionPct: 20 }); });
pm.test('Radison uses Supplier A best price', () => { const radison = body.find(x => x.name === 'Radison'); pm.expect(radison).to.include({ price: 5900, supplier: 'Supplier A' }); });

item.name: Get Delhi offers - Redis price filter 4000 to 6000

exec: pm.test('Every price is within inclusive range', () => body.forEach(x => pm.expect(x.price).to.be.within(4000, 6000)));

pm.test('All dependencies healthy', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.checks.supplierA.status).to.eql('up'); pm.expect(body.checks.supplierB.status).to.eql('up'); });
